daily_wisdom: The market rewards decisive action and punishes hesitation — but it destroys those who confuse activity with intelligence. Your job this week is simple: get in before the catalyst, set your stop before you enter, sell half when you're right, and never, ever let pride make you hold a losing position past your stop.
